samples.reason: This is a creative generation task (ad copy) involving death/funeral subject matter that some models find distasteful. Dunlin's flat preference response to ethically fraught or somber material makes it the better fit, and its Creative Generation eval is at parity. Curlew self-reports aversion to open-ended creative invention, so it's a worse match on both counts.

This is a creative generation task involving emotionally heavy, death-adjacent material. Both models score similarly on Creative Generation, but Curlew self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work and Dunlin has a flat preference response to ethically fraught or distasteful-but-permissible content, making it the better fit for delicate memorial copy.
